paragraphs.en: A national conference on health was held in Beijing from Oct. 12 to 13. Chinese President Xi Jinping, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), attended the conference and delivered an important speech. He stressed that the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030) is {{1}} to achieving the goal of building a Healthy China by 2035. China must remain firmly committed to the path of health development with Chinese characteristics and implement guidelines for the health work in the new era.
paragraphs.cn: 全国卫生大会于10月12日至13日在北京举行。中国国家主席、中共中央总书记、中央军委主席习近平出席会议并发表重要讲话。他强调，第十五个五年规划时期（2026-2030年）对于实现2035年建成健康中国的目标至关重要。中国必须坚定不移走中国特色卫生健康发展道路，实施新时代卫生工作方针。

paragraphs.en: The country should build on its strengths, {{2}} foundations, address {{3}} and shore up weak links to promote high-quality development of the health system, continuously improve the health of the people and ensure {{0}} progress in advancing the Healthy China Initiative. Li Qiang made concluding remarks at the conference, which was also attended by Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang and Li Xi. Xi noted that people's health is a key indicator of a {{4}} nation and a strong country. Since the 18th National Congress of the CPC in 2012, the CPC Central Committee has made safeguarding people's health a {{5}} priority in the country's development. It has established guidelines for the health work in the new era, and made major decisions and arrangements for building a Healthy China.
paragraphs.cn: 国家应当发挥优势、夯实基础、补齐短板、加固薄弱环节，推动卫生体系高质量发展，不断提高人民健康水平，确保健康中国建设取得决定性进展。李强在会议上作总结讲话，赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希也出席了会议。习近平指出，人民健康是民族昌盛和国家强盛的重要标志。自2012年党的十八大以来，党中央将保障人民健康作为国家发展的战略优先事项。党中央确立了新时代卫生工作方针，为健康中国建设作出了重大决策部署。

paragraphs.en: These efforts have led to the development of the world's largest systems for medical services, traditional medicine, disease prevention and control, and healthcare security, marking historic achievements and all-round progress in the health sector. We aim to build a Healthy China where balanced, {{6}}, high-quality and {{7}} health services are ensured, Xi said, adding that the country should have strong capacities in health management, disease prevention and control, medical services, medical insurance support, {{8}} {{19}} and talent development, so as to effectively meet people's ever-growing health needs and ensure {{9}} and steady improvements in key health indicators. Xi said that the health sector plays an {{10}} and foundational role, and it is necessary to {{11}} implement a strategy that prioritizes health. Safeguarding people's health must be factored into all policies and reflected in every aspect of work. In formulating plans, designing policies, evaluating projects, and carrying out construction, the impact on people's health must always be given top priority, Xi said.
paragraphs.cn: 这些努力促成了世界上最大的医疗服务体系、传统医药体系、疾病预防控制体系和医疗保障体系的发展，在卫生领域取得了历史性成就和全面进步。习近平说，我们的目标是建设一个均衡、包容、高质量、高效率的健康中国，确保提供优质高效的卫生服务。他补充说，国家应当在健康管理、疾病预防控制、医疗服务、医疗保险支撑、药品创新和人才培养等方面具备强大能力，以有效满足人民日益增长的健康需求，确保关键健康指标持续稳步改善。习近平说，卫生领域具有全局性和基础性作用，必须坚定不移实施健康优先发展战略。保障人民健康必须融入所有政策，体现在工作的各个方面。习近平说，在制定规划、设计政策、评估项目、开展建设时，必须始终把对人民健康的影响放在首位。

paragraphs.en: Emphasizing that prevention is the most cost-effective and efficient health strategy, Xi urged {{12}} efforts to strengthen foundational work concerning public health and healthcare and address health issues at their source, so as to lay a solid foundation for the health of the entire population. He said it is {{13}} to guide the public in developing a correct understanding of health and engaging in effective self-care and health management. Young people should be encouraged to develop good study and lifestyle habits and achieve well-rounded development in terms of moral grounding, intellectual capability, physical vigor, aesthetic sensibility and work skills. Efforts should be made to create a favorable ecological, working and living environment, encourage and support fitness for all and healthy leisure activities, and strengthen food safety {{14}} to ensure that every bite of food is safe. Xi also said the disease prevention and control system must be improved to ensure that no large-scale {{15}} occur.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平强调，预防是最具成本效益和最高效的卫生策略，他敦促精心加强公共卫生和医疗保健的基础性工作，从源头上解决健康问题，为全体人民的健康奠定坚实基础。他说，必须引导公众树立正确的健康观念，进行有效的自我保健和健康管理。应当鼓励年轻人养成良好的学习和生活习惯，在道德素养、智力能力、身体素质、审美情趣和劳动技能方面实现全面发展。应当努力创造良好的生态、工作和生活环境，鼓励和支持全民健身和健康休闲活动，加强食品安全监管，确保每一口食物都安全。习近平还说，必须完善疾病预防控制体系，确保不发生大规模流行病。

paragraphs.en: Xi noted that comprehensively improving medical services is a key task in building a Healthy China. It is essential to advance a program aimed at enhancing primary-level healthcare, {{16}} the functions and structural layout of healthcare institutions, and promote tiered diagnosis and treatment, so that people can readily access quality medical care close to home. It is necessary to strengthen comprehensive prevention and control of chronic diseases, and improve whole-chain services covering prevention, treatment, {{17}} and management. Mechanisms for the {{18}}, innovation, and development of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) should be improved to enhance integrated development of TCM and Western medicine. Xi called for efforts to strengthen basic research and original innovation in the health sector, facilitate the {{20}} of scientific and technological achievements into practical applications, and expand and strengthen the health industry.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平指出，全面提高医疗服务质量是建设健康中国的关键任务。必须推进基层医疗保健能力提升工程，优化医疗机构的功能和结构布局，推进分级诊疗，使人民能够就近获得优质医疗服务。必须加强慢性病的综合防控，完善涵盖预防、治疗、康复和管理的全链条服务。应当完善中医药传承创新发展机制，促进中西医结合发展。习近平呼吁加强卫生领域的基础研究和原始创新，促进科技成果转化为实际应用，做大做强健康产业。

paragraphs.en: He also said it is necessary to enhance the patient experience, and continuously improve public access to and {{21}} with healthcare services. Xi stressed that reform is a strong driving force for the development of the health sector, and that the {{22}} development and regulation of medical services, medical insurance and pharmaceuticals should be the primary focus of reforming the health system. Efforts must be made to fully implement the reform plan for public health and medical institutions, deepen public hospital reform with a commitment to their public-welfare nature, and provide greater support for the running of community-level healthcare facilities in counties and districts. Measures should be taken to establish a multi-tiered healthcare security system, with optimized policies on centralized {{23}} of drugs and consumables, medical insurance payments and fund utilization, so as to ensure the safe operation of insurance funds and the sound operation of hospitals, and keep healthcare expenses within an affordable range for the public. Efforts must be made to improve mechanisms for ensuring the supply and management of medicines, refine the national system of essential medicines, and strengthen oversight of pharmaceutical quality and safety.
paragraphs.cn: 他还说，必须提升患者体验，不断提高公众获得医疗服务的可及性和满意度。习近平强调，改革是卫生领域发展的强大动力，医疗服务、医疗保险和医药的协同发展与监管应当成为卫生体制改革的重点。必须全面实施公共卫生和医疗机构改革方案，深化公立医院改革，坚持其公益性质，加大对县区基层医疗设施运行的支持力度。应当采取措施建立多层次医疗保障体系，优化药品和耗材集中采购、医疗保险支付和基金使用政策，确保保险基金安全运行和医院良性运转，使医疗费用保持在公众可负担的范围内。必须努力完善药品供应和管理机制，完善国家基本药物制度，加强药品质量安全监管。

paragraphs.en: Xi noted that safeguarding people's health requires a strong {{24}} of management and healthcare professionals. It is necessary to select and appoint competent leadership teams at all levels of health authorities and healthcare institutions, their principal heads in particular, and strive to build a medical workforce that is sufficient in number, well-structured, and highly qualified. He also stressed enhancing work ethics and conduct, fostering a sound professional {{25}}, and promoting a social atmosphere of respect for medical professionals and high regard for the health profession. Xi stressed that health for all is a shared {{26}} of humanity. It is necessary to actively advance the building of a global community of health for all, join hands to address major challenges in the health sector, and continuously improve the health and well-being of people in all countries.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平指出，保障人民健康需要一支强大的管理和医疗卫生专业队伍。必须选拔和任用各级卫生主管部门和医疗机构的有能力的领导班子，特别是主要负责人，努力建设一支数量充足、结构合理、素质优良的医疗卫生队伍。他还强调要加强职业道德和作风建设，培育良好的职业风气，营造尊重医务人员和崇尚卫生职业的社会氛围。习近平强调，人人健康是人类的共同追求。必须积极推动构建人类卫生健康共同体，携手应对卫生领域的重大挑战，不断改善各国人民的健康和福祉。

paragraphs.en: Efforts should be made to deepen Belt and Road cooperation in health, strengthen and innovate China's health-related foreign assistance, and tell the story of a Healthy China well to further build international {{27}}. In his concluding remarks, Li Qiang said General Secretary Xi's important speech provides profound answers to a series of fundamental, directional, and overarching issues concerning health work. With great ideological, strategic, and guiding significance, the speech charts the course and provides essential guidelines for advancing China's health sector in the new era and on the new journey. Li called for actions to earnestly study and deeply understand the speech, implement it fully and without compromise, enhance consciousness in both thought and action, and {{28}} follow the path of health development with Chinese characteristics. Li stressed the needs to firmly establish a health-first approach to promote the coordinated development of people's health and economic and social progress; uphold the public-welfare nature of basic medical and health services to consolidate the foundation of health for all; place equal emphasis on ensuring basic services and improving quality to better meet people's diverse health needs; and deepen reform, innovation, opening up, and cooperation to continuously boost the driving force and vitality for the health sector's development.
paragraphs.cn: 应当努力深化健康领域的'一带一路'合作，加强和创新中国卫生对外援助，讲好健康中国故事，进一步凝聚国际共识。李强在总结讲话中说，习近平总书记的重要讲话深刻回答了一系列关于卫生工作的根本性、方向性、全局性问题。讲话具有重大的思想性、战略性和指导性，为在新时代新征程上推进中国卫生事业发展指明了方向、提供了根本遵循。李强呼吁切实学习和深刻领会讲话精神，全面不折不扣地贯彻落实，增强思想和行动自觉，坚定不移走中国特色卫生健康发展道路。李强强调，必须牢固树立健康优先的发展理念，促进人民健康与经济社会协调发展；坚持基本医疗卫生事业的公益性质，夯实全民健康基础；坚持保基本与提质量并重，更好满足人民多样化的健康需求；深化改革、创新、开放、合作，不断增强卫生事业发展的动力和活力。

paragraphs.en: We must focus on the pain points and bottlenecks in the health sector, and give priority to addressing the pressing difficulties and problems that concern the people most, Li said. Vigorous efforts should be made to prevent and control major diseases, advance the development of the tiered diagnosis and treatment system, improve people's experience of seeking and receiving medical services, build a multi-tiered healthcare security system, leverage the unique strengths of traditional Chinese medicine, improve health services for the elderly and children, and promote the empowerment of the medical and health sector by science and technology, so as to lay a solid foundation for building a Healthy China. Members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and members of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, vice chairperson of the CMC, leading officials of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, state councilors, the procurator-general of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and leading officials of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference attended the meeting. Also present at the meeting were leading officials of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government, cities specifically designated in the state plan, and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, leading officials from relevant central Party and government departments, people's organizations, some state-owned enterprises directly administered by the central government, and relevant departments of the CMC, as well as representatives of experts and scholars.
paragraphs.cn: 李强说，我们必须聚焦卫生领域的痛点和瓶颈，优先解决人民群众最关心最迫切的困难和问题。应当大力防治重大疾病，推进分级诊疗制度建设，改善人民群众看病就医体验，建立多层次医疗保障体系，发挥中医药独特优势，改善老年人和儿童健康服务，推动科学技术对医疗卫生事业的赋能，为建设健康中国奠定坚实基础。中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记、中央军委副主席、全国人大常委会领导同志、国务委员、最高人民检察院检察长、全国政协领导同志出席会议。各省、自治区、直辖市及计划单列市、新疆生产建设兵团领导同志，中央和国家机关有关部门、人民团体、部分中央管理国有企业、中央军委有关部门负责同志以及专家学者代表也参加了会议。

Chinese President Xi Jinping, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), attended the conference and delivered an important speech. He stressed that the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030) is crucial to achieving the goal of building a Healthy China by 2035. China must remain firmly committed to the path of health development with Chinese characteristics and implement guidelines for the health work in the new era. The country should build on its strengths, consolidate foundations, address shortcomings and shore up weak links to promote high-quality development of the health system, continuously improve the health of the people and ensure decisive progress in advancing the Healthy China Initiative.
Li Qiang made concluding remarks at the conference, which was also attended by Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang and Li Xi.
Xi noted that people's health is a key indicator of a prosperous nation and a strong country. Since the 18th National Congress of the CPC in 2012, the CPC Central Committee has made safeguarding people's health a strategic priority in the country's development. It has established guidelines for the health work in the new era, and made major decisions and arrangements for building a Healthy China. These efforts have led to the development of the world's largest systems for medical services, traditional medicine, disease prevention and control, and healthcare security, marking historic achievements and all-round progress in the health sector.
We aim to build a Healthy China where balanced, inclusive, high-quality and efficient health services are ensured, Xi said, adding that the country should have strong capacities in health management, disease prevention and control, medical services, medical insurance support, pharmaceutical innovation and talent development, so as to effectively meet people's ever-growing health needs and ensure sustained and steady improvements in key health indicators.
Xi said that the health sector plays an overarching and foundational role, and it is necessary to steadfastly implement a strategy that prioritizes health. Safeguarding people's health must be factored into all policies and reflected in every aspect of work. In formulating plans, designing policies, evaluating projects, and carrying out construction, the impact on people's health must always be given top priority, Xi said.
Emphasizing that prevention is the most cost-effective and efficient health strategy, Xi urged meticulous efforts to strengthen foundational work concerning public health and healthcare and address health issues at their source, so as to lay a solid foundation for the health of the entire population. He said it is imperative to guide the public in developing a correct understanding of health and engaging in effective self-care and health management. Young people should be encouraged to develop good study and lifestyle habits and achieve well-rounded development in terms of moral grounding, intellectual capability, physical vigor, aesthetic sensibility and work skills. Efforts should be made to create a favorable ecological, working and living environment, encourage and support fitness for all and healthy leisure activities, and strengthen food safety oversight to ensure that every bite of food is safe. Xi also said the disease prevention and control system must be improved to ensure that no large-scale epidemics occur.
Xi noted that comprehensively improving medical services is a key task in building a Healthy China. It is essential to advance a program aimed at enhancing primary-level healthcare, optimize the functions and structural layout of healthcare institutions, and promote tiered diagnosis and treatment, so that people can readily access quality medical care close to home. It is necessary to strengthen comprehensive prevention and control of chronic diseases, and improve whole-chain services covering prevention, treatment, rehabilitation and management. Mechanisms for the inheritance, innovation, and development of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) should be improved to enhance integrated development of TCM and Western medicine. Xi called for efforts to strengthen basic research and original innovation in the health sector, facilitate the translation of scientific and technological achievements into practical applications, and expand and strengthen the health industry. He also said it is necessary to enhance the patient experience, and continuously improve public access to and satisfaction with healthcare services.
Xi stressed that reform is a strong driving force for the development of the health sector, and that the coordinated development and regulation of medical services, medical insurance and pharmaceuticals should be the primary focus of reforming the health system. Efforts must be made to fully implement the reform plan for public health and medical institutions, deepen public hospital reform with a commitment to their public-welfare nature, and provide greater support for the running of community-level healthcare facilities in counties and districts. Measures should be taken to establish a multi-tiered healthcare security system, with optimized policies on centralized procurement of drugs and consumables, medical insurance payments and fund utilization, so as to ensure the safe operation of insurance funds and the sound operation of hospitals, and keep healthcare expenses within an affordable range for the public. Efforts must be made to improve mechanisms for ensuring the supply and management of medicines, refine the national system of essential medicines, and strengthen oversight of pharmaceutical quality and safety.
Xi noted that safeguarding people's health requires a strong contingent of management and healthcare professionals. It is necessary to select and appoint competent leadership teams at all levels of health authorities and healthcare institutions, their principal heads in particular, and strive to build a medical workforce that is sufficient in number, well-structured, and highly qualified. He also stressed enhancing work ethics and conduct, fostering a sound professional ethos, and promoting a social atmosphere of respect for medical professionals and high regard for the health profession.
Xi stressed that health for all is a shared aspiration of humanity. It is necessary to actively advance the building of a global community of health for all, join hands to address major challenges in the health sector, and continuously improve the health and well-being of people in all countries. Efforts should be made to deepen Belt and Road cooperation in health, strengthen and innovate China's health-related foreign assistance, and tell the story of a Healthy China well to further build international consensus.
In his concluding remarks, Li Qiang said General Secretary Xi's important speech provides profound answers to a series of fundamental, directional, and overarching issues concerning health work. With great ideological, strategic, and guiding significance, the speech charts the course and provides essential guidelines for advancing China's health sector in the new era and on the new journey. Li called for actions to earnestly study and deeply understand the speech, implement it fully and without compromise, enhance consciousness in both thought and action, and unswervingly follow the path of health development with Chinese characteristics.
Li stressed the needs to firmly establish a health-first approach to promote the coordinated development of people's health and economic and social progress; uphold the public-welfare nature of basic medical and health services to consolidate the foundation of health for all; place equal emphasis on ensuring basic services and improving quality to better meet people's diverse health needs; and deepen reform, innovation, opening up, and cooperation to continuously boost the driving force and vitality for the health sector's development.
We must focus on the pain points and bottlenecks in the health sector, and give priority to addressing the pressing difficulties and problems that concern the people most, Li said. Vigorous efforts should be made to prevent and control major diseases, advance the development of the tiered diagnosis and treatment system, improve people's experience of seeking and receiving medical services, build a multi-tiered healthcare security system, leverage the unique strengths of traditional Chinese medicine, improve health services for the elderly and children, and promote the empowerment of the medical and health sector by science and technology, so as to lay a solid foundation for building a Healthy China.
Members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and members of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, vice chairperson of the CMC, leading officials of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, state councilors, the procurator-general of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and leading officials of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference attended the meeting.
Also present at the meeting were leading officials of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government, cities specifically designated in the state plan, and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, leading officials from relevant central Party and government departments, people's organizations, some state-owned enterprises directly administered by the central government, and relevant departments of the CMC, as well as representatives of experts and scholars.

习近平强调，预防是最具成本效益和最高效的卫生策略，他敦促精心加强公共卫生和医疗保健的基础性工作，从源头上解决健康问题，为全体人民的健康奠定坚实基础。他说，必须引导公众树立正确的健康观念，进行有效的自我保健和健康管理。应当鼓励年轻人养成良好的学习和生活习惯，在道德素养、智力能力、身体素质、审美情趣和劳动技能方面实现全面发展。应当努力创造良好的生态、工作和生活环境，鼓励和支持全民健身和健康休闲活动，加强食品安全监管，确保每一口食物都安全。习近平还说，必须完善疾病预防控制体系，确保不发生大规模流行病。

习近平指出，全面提高医疗服务质量是建设健康中国的关键任务。必须推进基层医疗保健能力提升工程，优化医疗机构的功能和结构布局，推进分级诊疗，使人民能够就近获得优质医疗服务。必须加强慢性病的综合防控，完善涵盖预防、治疗、康复和管理的全链条服务。应当完善中医药传承创新发展机制，促进中西医结合发展。习近平呼吁加强卫生领域的基础研究和原始创新，促进科技成果转化为实际应用，做大做强健康产业。

他还说，必须提升患者体验，不断提高公众获得医疗服务的可及性和满意度。习近平强调，改革是卫生领域发展的强大动力，医疗服务、医疗保险和医药的协同发展与监管应当成为卫生体制改革的重点。必须全面实施公共卫生和医疗机构改革方案，深化公立医院改革，坚持其公益性质，加大对县区基层医疗设施运行的支持力度。应当采取措施建立多层次医疗保障体系，优化药品和耗材集中采购、医疗保险支付和基金使用政策，确保保险基金安全运行和医院良性运转，使医疗费用保持在公众可负担的范围内。必须努力完善药品供应和管理机制，完善国家基本药物制度，加强药品质量安全监管。

Potential buyers talk to salespeople at the ZXMOTO (Zhangxue Motorcycle) booth at the 140th China Import and Export Fair in Guangzhou, south China's Guangdong Province, October 15, 2026. 
The 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) has opened in the southern city of Guangzhou City, south China's Guangdong Province.
This year marks the 70th anniversary of the Canton Fair, which has played an important role in promoting trade between China and other countries.
It has become an effective platform for China to expand high-standard opening up and advance the development of an open world economy.
A survey conducted by CGTN among global respondents shows that 85.1% believe China's continued hosting of the Canton Fair demonstrates its resolve to advance high-standard opening up and injects sustained new momentum into inclusive and equitable economic globalization, and global development and prosperity.
For the first time, this year's Canton Fair has deeply integrated cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and big data into every stage of the event, introducing 22 smart application scenarios and 16 AI-powered features.
For example, exhibitors and buyers can exchange digital business cards by scanning QR codes, AI can automatically generate summaries of business negotiations, and the system can automatically archive customer information and identify high-potential orders.
In this regard, 84.1% of respondents believe that the Canton Fair is evolving from a traditional trading platform into an intelligent exhibition and service platform.
In addition, this year's fair has, for the first time, introduced a dedicated zone for new product launches. More than 700 new product launch events are expected to be held, representing a 15% increase in the number of new products unveiled.
The number of new products in emerging industries of the future, including service robotics, smart healthcare, intelligent manufacturing and new energy, is expected to rise by around 20% compared with the previous edition.
About 83% of respondents say this reflects a shift in China's foreign trade from expansion in scale toward improvements in quality and product mix. Another 85.6% believe that “Intelligent Manufacturing in China” is becoming an important driver of the global digital and intelligent economies.
Notably, this year's Canton Fair has established nine dedicated zones for trade services, for the first time covering all 10 major categories of producer services and providing businesses with full life-cycle support as they expand into overseas markets.
About 84.5% of respondents believe that this integrated ecosystem combining trade and services has significantly enhanced the international competitiveness of businesses and their products.
The fair has also established a buyers' alliance for the first time to promote information sharing and resource coordination among its members.
A total of 83.9% of respondents say the alliance's structured and institutionalized operations can effectively improve global procurement efficiency and strengthen ties between supply and demand, while 88.8% believe that the continuous upgrading of the fair's services and products has enhanced China's influence in global supply chain governance.
Amid global market volatility and a complex, changing geopolitical landscape, the Canton Fair continues to bring together buyers and exhibitors from around the world with an open and inclusive approach.
The previous edition attracted 314,000 overseas buyers from 220 countries and regions, generating intended export deals worth $25.7 billion. Its global reach continues to expand, with more than 210,000 buyers from 196 countries and regions having pre-registered before this year's fair opened.
A total of 87.2% of respondents say the Canton Fair provides an important opportunity for the international community to share in the benefits of China's vast market.
Meanwhile, 77.2% call on countries to work with China to uphold the multilateral trading system, ensure the stability and smooth functioning of global industrial and supply chains, and continue to expand mutually beneficial international economic and trade cooperation.
The survey was published on CGTN's English, Spanish, French, Arabic and Russian platforms, attracting 4,498 overseas respondents who shared their views within 24 hours.

Majid Al-Nuzaili, spokesperson for Yemen's government forces, said they had carried out 2,309 "precise and direct" hits against Houthi positions by warplanes, drones, field artillery, rocket launchers and sniper units.

International female youths learn how to use AI tools to promote and showcase products in online stores in Yiwu, Zhejiang Province, April 22, 2025. 
"At that moment, I realized I had to master this technology," said Saba Aliyeva, a participant from Azerbaijan, after trying AI photo editing for the first time during a training program in Dongguan, south China's Guangdong Province, in June 2026.
She was among 51 women from 10 countries who took part in two training programs on AI, digital entrepreneurship and technology empowerment, organized to help women from developing countries build skills for the digital age.
Their experience reflects China's ongoing efforts to turn digital technologies into practical opportunities for women, a vision also underscored by Peng Liyuan, wife of Chinese President Xi Jinping and a UNESCO special envoy for the advancement of girls' and women's education.
In a video address to the 2026 UNESCO Prize for Girls' and Women's Education award ceremony on Friday, Peng called on the international community to strengthen vocational education and training for women and expand digital and intelligent education, enabling them to use and benefit from these technologies.
She noted that China's use of AI to improve education quality had helped advance gender equality in education and women's all-round development, offering useful experience for countries in the Global South.
The demand for such empowerment is substantial. Research by the International Finance Corporation found that greater female participation in e-commerce markets in Africa and Southeast Asia could generate over $300 billion in revenue between 2025 and 2030.
China is expanding women's digital skills through national initiatives on digital literacy and rural development, including training programs and support for women-led e-commerce businesses. In 2024, 14,147 women obtained vocational skills certificates as AI trainers, accounting for 42.3% of the annual total. Women also account for more than half of entrepreneurs in China's internet sector and about one-third of workers in emerging fields such as digital trade, e-commerce and livestreaming.
China is also sharing its experience internationally. Established in July 2025, the Global Exchange and Cooperation Center for Digital Empowerment of Women reflects the goals outlined by President Xi in a congratulatory letter to the 2024 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Forum on Women, in which he expressed China's willingness to work with all parties to promote scientific and technological innovation and women's development through digital empowerment.
Beyond skills training, China advocates for inclusive digital governance. Through its Global AI Governance Initiative, launched at the third Belt and Road Forum, China called for eliminating gender bias in AI development. Furthermore, China promoted the resolution on "Enhancing International Cooperation on Capacity-building of Artificial Intelligence," adopted at the UN General Assembly, to improve digital inclusion and promote gender equality.
As Peng said on Friday, education for girls and women sows the seeds of hope, nurtures dreams and reaps happiness. By combining practical skills training with international exchanges and cooperation, China is contributing to efforts to ensure that more women can use digital technologies, participate in the digital economy and benefit from the digital transformation.

2025年4月22日，在浙江义乌，国际女青年学习如何使用人工智能工具在网店中推广和展示产品。“那一刻，我意识到我必须掌握这项技术，”来自阿塞拜疆的参与者萨巴·阿利耶娃在2026年6月于中国南部广东省东莞参加培训项目时首次尝试AI照片编辑后说道。她是来自10个国家的51名女性之一，参加了两个关于人工智能、数字创业和技术赋能的培训项目，这些项目旨在帮助发展中国家女性掌握数字时代的技能。她们的经历反映了中国持续努力将数字技术转化为女性的实际机会，这一愿景也得到中国国家主席习近平的夫人、联合国教科文组织促进女童和妇女教育特使彭丽媛的强调。在周五向2026年联合国教科文组织女童和妇女教育奖颁奖典礼发表的视频致辞中，彭丽媛呼吁国际社会加强女性职业教育和培训，扩大数字和智能教育，使她们能够使用并受益于这些技术。她指出，中国利用人工智能提高教育质量有助于促进教育中的性别平等和女性全面发展，为全球南方国家提供了有益经验。

对此类赋能的需求十分巨大。国际金融公司的研究发现，非洲和东南亚电子商务市场中女性参与度的提高，可能在2025年至2030年间带来超过3000亿美元的收入。中国正在通过数字素养和农村发展等国家倡议扩大女性的数字技能，包括培训项目和对女性主导的电子商务企业的支持。2024年，14147名女性获得了人工智能训练师职业技能证书，占全年总数的42.3%。在中国互联网行业，女性还占创业者的一半以上，在数字贸易、电子商务和直播等新兴领域约占从业人员的三分之一。中国也在国际上分享其经验。

2025年7月成立的全球数字赋能妇女发展交流合作中心，体现了习近平主席在致2024年上海合作组织妇女论坛贺信中提出的目标，他在信中表示中国愿与各方一道，通过数字赋能促进科技创新和妇女发展。除了技能培训，中国还倡导包容性数字治理。通过在第三届“一带一路”国际合作高峰论坛上提出的《全球人工智能治理倡议》，中国呼吁消除人工智能发展中的性别偏见。此外，中国推动联合国大会通过了“加强人工智能能力建设国际合作”决议，以改善数字包容并促进性别平等。正如彭丽媛周五所说，女童和妇女教育播下希望的种子，培育梦想，收获幸福。通过将实用技能培训与国际交流合作相结合，中国正在为努力确保更多女性能够使用数字技术、参与数字经济并受益于数字转型作出贡献。
